title: Listen to a sentence and say what it means
intro: You will see a short topic line and one sentence that a person said to you. Say what you think the person is saying, how you would respond, and how sure you are.
Sentences come from different sources: some were written by a person, some were produced by a program. Do not try to guess the source. Answer only from what the sentence says to you.

help.text: Two readings are shown. Choose the one the sentence says to you. If it says neither, or you cannot tell, choose 'Something else, or I cannot tell'.
Choose the response that fits what you understood. 'Ask them to say it again or confirm' is right when you are not sure what they mean.
1 means you are guessing, 3 means you are sure.

q1.text: Choose the message the sentence says. If it fits neither, or you cannot tell, choose the last option.
